# UX, Controls & Mobile Requirements Checklist: Arkanoid Integration

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the requirements for game states, on-screen messages, controls and mobile play before `/speckit-tasks`
**Created**: 2026-11-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Focus**: UX & game states; controls & mobile · **Depth**: Standard · **Audience**: author, before task breakdown

## Requirement Completeness — game states & messages

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact Spanish texts specified for every in-between notice, including the "how to continue" hint of "Nivel N completado"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the asset-loading error state defined as a requirement (message text, retry control, what retry does), or only as an edge case? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan R4]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec define what the loading screen's progress represents for this game (real asset loading vs. the current simulated bar)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the loading-screen tip for this game specified, or only the requirement that it must not mention missing features? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the visual properties of the "¡VICTORIA!" title (colour, glow) specified, or explicitly delegated to the existing end-screen style? [Gap, Spec §US3-3]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the order of screens after winning with a new record (¡NUEVO RÉCORD! → save → ¡VICTORIA!) defined for both "Guardar récord" and leaving without saving? [Coverage, Spec §US3-3]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it specified whether pause is available while waiting to launch and during "Nivel N completado", not only mid-rally? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 Does the spec state where and how an auto-pause (tab hidden, window blur) is shown and resumed — same PAUSA overlay, or resume automatically? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is the placement of the "waiting to launch" notice specified so it does not hide the paddle, ball or bricks? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "in the portal's visual style" defined by reference to specific existing elements (e.g. "PRESS START", "PAUSA") precisely enough to review? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "crisp pixel art" in FR-011 defined in a verifiable way (e.g. no smoothing/blur at any scale)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK012 Does FR-012 choose between "hidden" and "disabled" for unused touch buttons, or does "hidden or disabled" leave two acceptable outcomes? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the HUD level format for this game defined (e.g. `01`–`03` desktop, `LV 01` mobile), given the demo derives level from score? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "mid-range laptop / phone" in SC-004 specified enough to make the 60 fps target objectively checkable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Does SC-007 ("no English text") conflict with the design's existing "PRESS START", "GAME OVER" and "INSERT COIN TO CONTINUE", and is an explicit exception or translation recorded? [Conflict, Spec §SC-007, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the launch notice text consistent across inputs: FR-003 says "Pulsa Espacio o toca", while US1-2 allows Space, click and tap? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §US1-2]
- [ ] CHK017 Do Escape-to-pause (FR-008) and Escape-to-exit-full-screen (browser default, US2-5) conflict, and is the intended behaviour in full screen specified? [Conflict, Spec §FR-008, Spec §US2-5]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the extension of per-game controls to the detail page (Plan R11) reflected in the spec, or is it a scope addition outside FR-012? [Consistency, Plan R11, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK019 Are "Reiniciar" (cabinet) and "Reintentar" (end screen, error state) used for distinct actions without overlapping meaning? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Plan R4]

## Controls — scenario & edge coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Is the precedence defined when keyboard and mouse/drag move the paddle at the same time? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the distinction between a tap (launch) and a drag (move) on the game area specified, so a drag does not launch the ball? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018, Spec §US4-3]
- [ ] CHK022 Is it specified whether the mouse controls the paddle only over the game area or anywhere on the page? [Clarity, Spec §US1-3, Plan R7]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for which keys stay active while overlays (pause, end, record entry) are shown, so gameplay keys do not leak into them? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the "Space at PRESS START does not also launch" rule written as a requirement rather than only an edge case? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Mobile layout & full screen

- [ ] CHK025 Is the mobile layout defined for landscape orientation (phone rotated), not only the 390 px portrait width? [Gap, Spec §US4, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are full-screen requirements defined for mobile, where the design shows no "Pantalla completa" button? [Gap, Spec §US2-5]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the placement of the "Gráficos: Petraheim" credit specified for both desktop and mobile so it stays visible without scrolling? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK028 Is "fully visible without scrolling" at 390 px defined together with the touch pad and HUD heights (which viewport height is assumed)? [Measurability, Spec §US4-1]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the 4:3 mobile slot recorded as limited to engine games, so the demo games' 3:4 slot is explicitly unchanged? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-016]

## Non-functional — accessibility

- [ ] CHK030 Are accessible names specified for the game area and the reduced touch-pad buttons in Spanish? [Gap, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for announcing score, lives and level changes or end-of-game results to assistive technologies? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK032 Is keyboard focus behaviour specified when overlays appear and disappear (pause, level complete, end screens, error)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK033 Is `prefers-reduced-motion` behaviour specified for the new notices and the brick explosion animation? [Gap, Constitution §II]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Highest-risk items to settle before `/speckit-tasks`: CHK015, CHK017, CHK002, CHK021
